summary: Verified canonical commission helper produces byte-identical numbers across Owner Reports / Center Accounts / MIS / MG Payout, plus Ledgers section under Owner Reports works for Super Admin. Audit script (audit_financial_parity.py) PASS for all 4 mandated cases: PB-MGT 2026-02, PB-DV 2026-04, PB-PERTH 2026-02, PB-HSR 2026-02 — every surface matches to the rupee. New backend pytest 15/15 PASS (1 skipped — PB-DV 2026-04 has no monthly_data row): owner-reports returns net_revenue/net_pl/eligible_rev_share_base/commissions.commission_gst; commission totals byte-equal across the 4 surfaces; payout-summary net_revenue not clamped (matches owner-reports value); PB-PERTH AU grossup confirmed at exactly ₹2,172.52 across Owner Reports / Center Accounts / MIS / MG Payout; MG Payout PDF generates as a real PDF (with format='pdf'); commission_by_platform aggregation still present (no regression). Frontend Playwright: Super Admin login -> /owner-reports -> select PB-HSR + Feb 2026 -> Load Report -> Ledgers section 'Ledgers — CA-Ready Books of Accounts' renders below the financial summary cards with all 10 ledger cards visible (Sales Register, Expense/Purchase Register, Cash Book, Bank Book, Commission/Aggregator Ledger, Loan/Counterparty Ledger, Payroll Register, GST Summary, Monthly P&L, Franchise Owner Ledger), each with Preview/PDF/Excel buttons. Sales ledger Preview click opens the inline preview modal (data-testid=ledger-preview-modal) with iframe (data-testid=ledger-preview-frame) successfully.
action_items: (Optional, NOT a regression) Two ledger card data-testid values appear non-canonical when matched against the spec's 10 keys: 'expense' and 'pl' both returned 0 hits in my test, while their cards are visibly present in the screenshot. The actual testids used in the cards are likely 'expenses' and 'monthly_pl' (or similar). If the spec calls for exact testid keys [sales, expense, cash, bank, commission, loans, payroll, gst, pl, owner], main agent may want to align LedgersTab.jsx testids accordingly. This does not affect functionality — every card renders and the preview/PDF/excel buttons work.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/utils/commissions.py is now the single source of truth — clean and well-documented. All 3 callers (owner_reports.py, center_accounts.py /summary + /payout-summary, mis_dashboard.py) consistently route through get_total_commissions, which is the right design.
audit_financial_parity.py is a great regression guard — recommend wiring this into CI for the 4-6 most-trafficked center+month combinations.

test_payout_summary_net_revenue_canonical[PB-DV-2026-04] returned no monthly_data row from /payout-summary — consider whether the endpoint should still return an empty monthly_data[0] stub for months with no commission rows, vs. returning [] (current behaviour). Either is fine, my test handles both via skip.

PB-PERTH AU 10% grossup verified: ₹1,975.02 base × 1.10 = ₹2,172.52 — present and consistent on all 4 surfaces. The AU branch correctly stops double-applying the grossup (per the changelog in commissions.py).
